riskSelected: Provider close could abort queued Web Locks and in-flight puts, but raw OPFS open/bucket acquisition and guarded open were not fully covered by close-composed provider signals.
substance: Added signal-aware raw OPFS prefix-root/open path with abort checkpoints around origin root and prefix directory steps.
Added signal-aware mutable bucket open checkpoints before/after digest bucket directory acquisition.
Changed WebLockGuardedBlockStore.open(options) to pass providerOptions through to the underlying store open.
Extended existing close-abort probes/audits instead of registering another proof family.
refactor: Compacted the new raw open helper after package source-budget audit showed the src ratchet had less than one kilobyte of margin.
Kept the package tarball boundary under 75 files and 1.45 MB src bytes without widening limits.
nonClaims: No OPFS quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, Service Worker lifetime, crash recovery, Web Lock fairness, or cross-browser proof.
Close-owned cancellation is local lifecycle hygiene; individual browser directory calls may still complete before the next cooperative abort checkpoint.
